output.rationale: The requirement specifies compliance with IEEE C37.41 for high-voltage fuses and switchgear. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineup, which aligns with the specification for metal-clad switchgear and adheres to relevant IEEE standards. This makes it the most suitable choice for the requirement.
